meta.title: Feedback for Candy Heist
meta.description: An unreleased track, shared for your notes.

gate.lead: Candy Heist would like your ears on

name.label: Your name
name.placeholder: So Candy knows who it's from

gate.private: Only Candy reads what you send. Nobody else with this link sees it.
gate.unreleased: Unreleased. Please keep it to yourself.

room.unplayable: This track can't be played here. Try another browser.
room.hint: Press the waveform to move through the track. Drag across it to mark out a section.
room.compareHint: Put a tool on to hear the before and after.

notes.label: Notes
notes.empty: Nothing yet. Leave a note at the playhead, or mark out a section and put tools on it.
notes.full: That's as many notes as one send holds.

tools.label: Tools
tools.noSection: Mark out a section on the waveform, or pick one from the notes, to put tools on just that part.

devices.label: Devices
devices.hint: Drag one into the chain, or tap it to add it at the end.
devices.full: That's as many devices as one chain holds.
devices.empty: Nothing in the chain yet. Drag a device here.
devices.earlier: Move it earlier in the chain
devices.later: Move it later in the chain

eq.hint: Press the line to add a point, and drag it where you want it. Scroll over a point to widen or narrow it.
eq.full: That's as many points as one EQ holds.

dynamics.hint: A guide to what you mean, not a mastering processor.

submit.nothing: Leave a note or put a tool on the track first.

sent.title: Sent to Candy
sent.text: Thank you. You can keep listening and send more.

invalid.title: That couldn't be sent
invalid.text: Something in it doesn't fit. Check your notes and try again.

limited.title: That's a lot of sends
limited.text: Wait a while and send again. Nothing you've written is lost.

closed.title: This link has closed
closed.text: It closed before your notes arrived. Ask Candy for a new one.

failed.title: That didn't send
failed.text: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing you've written is lost; try again in a moment.

closed.headline: This link has closed.
closed.text: Feedback links stay open for a few days. If you were asked for your notes, ask Candy for a new link.
